epic.title: Ship a useful side IT project
epic.identity: Someone who finishes small tools end-to-end
epic.capability: Design, build, and ship a focused side project without endless rewrites
epic.preview: A working local demo you can show in under five minutes

phases.title: Scope the problem
phases.deliverable: One-page brief: user, problem, non-goals, and success check

steps.title: Write the primary user and the pain in one paragraph
List three explicit non-goals to protect focus
Define a five-minute demo success check

phases.title: Build the thin vertical slice
phases.deliverable: Runnable core path with tests for the happy case

steps.title: Scaffold the repo and a single runnable entrypoint
Implement the core path without polish
Add tests that lock the happy path

phases.title: Ship and close the loop
phases.deliverable: Tagged release notes + short demo recording or walkthrough

steps.title: Write a clear README with run steps
Tag a v0.1 release and note what is intentionally unfinished
Record or rehearse the five-minute demo
